<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple guarantees (model guarantees@1): the heading, a description and the promises as a list, each with a
  short title and a line. Text only. Axes: layout (strip: the promises side by side on one muted band; cards: a
  card surface per promise), cols (4, 3 columns from md up).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Guarantee } from "./guarantees-simple.types";

export type GuaranteesSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  items: Guarantee[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "strip" | "cards";
  cols?: "4" | "3";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  items,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "strip",
  cols = "4",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<GuaranteesSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const grid = computed(() =>
  (cols as string) === "3" ? "grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3"
  : "grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4"
);
const band = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "cards") ? "" : "rounded bg-muted p-8");
const item = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "cards" ? "rounded border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground flex flex-col gap-2"
  : "flex flex-col gap-2"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="guarantees-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Box :class="band">
          <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid', grid))">
            <ListItem v-for="g in items" :key="g.id" :class="cn(item, itemsAlign)" data-slot="guarantee">
              <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="base" weight="semibold" :class="textAlign">
                {{ g.title }}
              </Title>
              <Text v-if="g.text" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
                {{ g.text }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
